verdict.rationale: A tax authority could plausibly publish a developer API reference (for example, for e-file or payment integrations), so the axis applies. The evidence pack records only Akamai 403 denials at robots.txt and at the filing/payment app host. Nothing shows an API reference, interactive or not, or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
